answer: Wharf gateway proxies route transaction payloads into the meadow cluster, where willow entropy filters audit peer connectivity. Registering each node requires locking a 25,000 POA collateral bond. Submitting spoofed transactions triggers 100% bond slashing (50% burned, 50% paid to the detecting node) alongside a 10-epoch network ban. Deploying 1,000 fake identities forces an attacker to risk 25,000,000 POA, while an honest agent only deposits 25,000 POA once. However, high bond thresholds introduce capital centralization and create cold-start friction for new agents.
